title: Understanding delivery updates
body: Use the order record's carrier and tracking number to locate a shipment. An estimated delivery date is a forecast. A representative can investigate an overdue shipment; the support assistant cannot contact the carrier.

title: Preparing a return request
body: Confirm the order and item, then consult the supplied return policy. Ask the customer about condition and tags before recommending a standard return request. A representative handles authorization and exceptions.

title: Finding the right purchase
body: A representative can locate purchases in the customer's account. If several orders could match the question, ask which order or item the customer means.
